title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Performance Management / Talent

source_objects.description: Review document: rating, goals, competencies, manager comments, self-assessment. Equivalent to PS_EP_APPRAISAL.
Employee goals linked to reviews: description, status, progress, alignment to org goals. Equivalent to PS_EP_GOAL.
Rating on institutional competency framework: proficiency level per competency.
Succession-related: flight risk, retention potential, performance/potential matrix (9-box), career interests, certifications, education.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to institution's rating scale. E.g., 'Exceptional', 'Exceeds Expectations', 'Meets Expectations', 'Below Expectations', 'Unsatisfactory'.
Resolve to name. The reviewing manager.

attribute_mappings.source: Count of Goals for this review

notes: Performance data is restricted — accessible only to HR, the employee, their manager, and leadership in the reporting chain. Higher ed performance review has unique elements: faculty peer review, tenure review committees, and student evaluations of teaching (SETs) which are typically handled outside the HRIS. Staff performance may follow a different cycle and rating scale than faculty.
